scope: First complete 48-question evaluation per method on authored trusted partial templates; three FinBench-derived families, one shared relation hole and supplied source assignments. Existing 24/48/48 split, semantics, permissions, costs and estimator frozen. Not arbitrary NL or official FinBench interactive-query conformance. No inherited old method results.

protocol.group_order: original cohort evaluation order, unchanged before outcomes
protocol.method_order: cyclic rotation by group index; 48 groups balance positions for two/six methods
protocol.healthy_session: reuse; fresh after failed method, no rerun
protocol.query_answers: existing pinned independent reference, post-seal only
protocol.costs: online admission, acquisition, planning, source execution and durable records; serving/profile publication/catalog/statistics/estimator/summary preparation separately
protocol.missing_or_failed_methods: all-denominator correctness, no zero latency; efficiency subset must declare joint support/success and session warmth
protocol.paper_comparison: native two XGAP modes; same-facts RDF six explicitly composed methods; no cross-engine raw speedup claim
protocol.next_repetitions: not part of this release; preselect 12 groups and three time blocks in a later frozen association
